html.body: Name: lysosomal proton-transporting V-type ATPase complex Charge: 0 A proton-transporting two-sector ATPase complex found in the lysosomal membrane, where it acts as a proton pump to mediate acidification of the lysosomal lumen.
Pubmed_ID: 32353859 Nsp6 binds SIGMAR1 [PMID: 32353859] Not sure if the binding happens in the ER, in the cytoplasm or at the nucleus
